title: 第19章 遗忘第20章 异人
content_zh:
天蒙蒙亮，滴水岩。
连串水珠从石缝渗出，坠入水桶叮咚响，猎户俯身提桶，溢出来的水打湿草鞋，熟练将另一只空桶稳稳置於岩下，任水珠继续敲出清响。
拎桶沿小路转过一道弯，空中飘来阵阵粥香味。
吃早饭时，迟客见年轻人有些魂不守舍，以为昨晚没睡好，可细看之下瞧出几分不寻常端倪。
迟客于相术一道，虽未登堂入室，倒也略通一点皮毛。
何止脸色差，分明是一副重孝模样！
有些事，知道了也不能说破，倘若他悲痛过度，前不着村后不着店的山路上病倒，该去哪里寻医问药？
好歹也是别家有头有脸的子弟，如果在自己这荒山野岭出了差池，凭白惹上麻烦。
想法子让他多吃些饭，再多带点干粮饼。
临行前，将猎户拉到门后再三叮嘱。
“务必将他平安送出山，最好送到镇里，在公人面前露个面。”
猎户郑重点头。
“大人放心，我省得，可您的安全怎么办？”
迟客不以为意摆了摆手。
“不妨事，有蛇兄和狐狸在，若真有贼人，我搬到巨岩窝棚暂住几日便是。”
猎户略一思忖觉得此法可行，背起猎弓行囊手握铁叉，率先大步踏出院门。
黄狗仰头看看主人脸色，乖乖留下来，坐台阶上看家护院。
抱拳互相道别，迟客立于院门前，目送年轻人背影在蜿蜒的山道上渐行渐远，秋日少了树叶遮蔽，二人背影虽在转角处一时消失，片刻后却又在更远的山道上浮现，如此再三，方才彻底隐没于群山之间。
秋风拂过衣襟，忽然触景生情，母亲逝去时无言的钝痛，仿佛穿越岁月再度漫上心头。
这苍茫人世，生离死别，谁人能躲的过呢。

“唉……”
一声叹息，萧瑟如秋风。
带上书本和垫子，去寻两位山野好友参玄炼炁。
巨岩上。
黑蛇昂首正对朝霞呼吸山雾，狐狸打呵欠朝小路眺望，看见迟客出现后尾巴上扬。
狐狸坐在高处树旁盯着迟客走近，然后立起，抬前爪学着抱拳。
迟客微笑抱拳，攀上巨岩端坐吐纳。
而黑蛇仍深陷如何应对潜在威胁的思虑中，旁的事无所谓，唯独威胁必须重视，能无视距离突然出现，今后还怎能安心睡眠？如果能够多观察几次就好了，兴许能从中发现更多细节。
瞥了眼身旁正襟端坐的迟客，感叹此类走兽个个不简单，除了擅长叫唤，还有招引虚影的本事。
等晨雾散尽，阳光为山野带来暖意。
迟客展开书本开始讲课。
狐狸竖起双耳听得最是认真，眼睛里偶尔因领悟而闪过一抹灵动的喜色，相较之下，一旁的黑蛇虽也在听，却静默如磐石。
迟客觉得狐狸聪慧，学人举止，静聆典籍，暗赞此兽灵性非凡，怕是已修得几分道行了。
入荒僻山野隐居，竟得遇两个灵兽，不知名山大川，又是何等非凡光景。
闲坐岩上剥着松子，渴了饮一口葫芦里的山泉水。
日头渐至中天，狐狸倏然转身窜入林间。
不过片刻又疾奔而回，将松塔轻轻放在迟客膝前，接着回到高处松树旁老位置。
content_en:
The sky is bright and the water is dripping from the rock.
A series of water droplets seeped out from the cracks in the stone, making a tinkling sound as they fell into the bucket. Orion leaned over to carry the bucket, and the overflowing water wet his straw sandals. He skillfully placed the other empty bucket firmly under the rock, and let the water droplets continue to make a clear sound.
Carrying the bucket and turning a corner along the path, the scent of porridge floated in the air.
While having breakfast, Chi Ke saw that the young man was a little distracted and thought he had not slept well last night, but upon closer inspection he could see something unusual.
Chi Ke is a physiognomist. Although he has not entered the hall, he has a little knowledge of it.
Not only does his face look bad, he is clearly looking very filial!
There are some things that cannot be explained even if they are known. If he is too grieved and falls ill on a mountain road with no village or shop, where should he go to seek medical advice?
After all, he is also a respectable child from another family. If something goes wrong in this barren mountain and wilderness, he will get into trouble for nothing.
Try to find a way to let him eat more food and bring more dry food cakes.
Before leaving, he pulled Orion behind the door and warned him repeatedly.
"Be sure to send him out of the mountain safely, preferably to the town, where he can show his face to the public."
Orion nodded solemnly.
"Don't worry, sir. I don't have to worry about it, but what about your safety?"
Chi Ke waved his hand indifferently.
"It doesn't matter, Brother Snake and Fox are here. If there is really a thief, I will move to the giant rock shack to stay temporarily for a few days."
The hunter thought for a while and felt that this method was feasible. He picked up his hunting bag and took the iron fork in his hand, and strode out of the door first.
The yellow dog raised his head to look at his master's face, then stayed and sat on the steps to watch the home.
Holding fists and bidding farewell to each other, Chi Ke stood in front of the courtyard gate and watched the young man's back drifting further and further away on the winding mountain road. In the autumn, there were no leaves to cover them. Although the two people's backs disappeared for a moment at the corner, they reappeared on the mountain road farther away a moment later. They repeated this process again and again before they were completely hidden among the mountains.
The autumn wind blew through my clothes, and I was suddenly moved by the scene. The silent dull pain when my mother passed away seemed to fill my heart again through time.
In this vast world, no one can escape the separation of life and death.
"Alas..."
A sigh, as desolate as the autumn wind.
Bring your books and mats with you and go find two friends from the mountains to practice Xuan Qi.
On the huge rock.
The black snake raised its head to face the morning glow and breathed in the mountain mist. The fox yawned and looked towards the path, raising its tail after seeing the late guest.
The fox sat next to a high tree and watched Chi Ke approaching, then stood up, raised his front paws and learned to clasp his fists.
Chi Ke smiled and clasped his fists, climbed up the rock and sat upright to breathe.
And Black Snake is still deeply involved in thinking about how to deal with potential threats. Other things don't matter, only threats must be taken seriously. If he can suddenly appear regardless of distance, how can he sleep peacefully in the future? It would be nice if we could observe it a few more times, maybe we could find more details.
Glancing at Chi Ke who was sitting upright next to him, he lamented that these beasts are not simple. In addition to being good at calling, they also have the ability to attract phantoms.
When the morning fog clears, the sun brings warmth to the mountains.
Chi Ke opened his book and began to lecture.
The fox raised his ears and listened most attentively, and occasionally a flash of joy flashed through his eyes due to realization. In comparison, the black snake beside him was as silent as a rock although he was also listening.
Chi Ke felt that the fox was intelligent, imitated people's behavior, and listened quietly to the classics. He secretly praised the beast for its extraordinary spirituality, and he was afraid that it had already achieved some level of Taoism.
Going into seclusion in the remote mountains, I unexpectedly encountered two spiritual beasts. Unknown mountains and rivers, what an extraordinary scene it was.
Sitting on the rock peeling pine nuts, I drank a sip of mountain spring water from the gourd when I was thirsty.
The sun was getting high in the sky, and the fox suddenly turned around and ran into the forest.
But after a while, he ran back quickly, placed the pine cone gently in front of Chi Ke's knees, and then returned to his old position high up beside the pine tree.
